summary: A review-only v7 MatRIS path package now uses immutable initial restraint targets, graded transient O-H rollback evidence, explicit O-H reaction-coordinate redistribution after every restrained stage, and a stronger unrestrained ordinary-NEB spacing spring; strength-4 replay passes all local geometry gates and no job was submitted.

payload.objective: Review the exact v7 request and decide whether to authorize a separate MZ73 preflight and one bounded GPU execution.
current_evidence: The v6 root cause was cumulative retargeting: each release stage adopted the already drifted current path as its next restraint target.

The v7 executor can bind every release stage to immutable initial-request targets and redistributes the full minimum-image path after each restrained stage using O-H boundary anchors at images 09 and 15 plus five strict interval anchors at images 10-14.

Transient O-H rollback is graded as pass <=0.05 A, borderline warning from 0.05-0.07 A, and strong-warning/stop-candidate above 0.07 A; one rollback scalar alone no longer produces automatic scientific failure.

The final unrestrained path still has a hard whole-path 0.01 A monotonicity limit and strict-pass/borderline-review interval coverage, so the softer transient classification does not weaken final path acceptance.

Replay on job 1328's completed strength-4 snapshot restores strict O-H interval images 10-14; maximum adjacent RMSD is 0.195354 A, maximum movable-atom step is 0.862488 A, minimum pair distance is 0.977781 A, C1-C2 and PBC pass, and the largest exact O-H correction is 0.006133 A.

All temporary restraints are configured for removal before ordinary MatRIS ML-NEB; the ordinary image-spacing spring is 0.50 eV/A2 and the redistributed restrained stages remain path-preparation artifacts rather than MEPs.
No remote preflight, upload, GPU execution, VASP/VTST submission, Dimer, TS, barrier, fine-tuning, or automatic retry was performed.
payload.one_executable_step: Review request SHA-256 949f9888b1313cf9eec0192683e239d08cab98bfb88e6a3e11aeee74a6735210; any remote preflight or GPU execution requires a new explicit user authorization.
payload.submission_boundary: The v7 package is review-only. Do not upload, run a remote preflight, submit GPU/VASP/VTST work, fine-tune, prepare Dimer, or claim a TS/barrier without the corresponding explicit authorization and current gates.
done_when: The user accepts or rejects the exact hash-bound v7 design.
If accepted, a separately authorized MZ73 preflight validates runtime, checkpoint, image, and executor hashes before any execution decision.
